content.text:
No, it doesn't match. Our records show a total of EUR 5.922.761,95 for the Weber family, not EUR 6.4 million. The figure is from the portfolio report as of 30.09.2026. [source: weber-report] The call note of 01.10.2026 gives the same total. [source: weber-note-1]

The report breaks the total down as follows:
- Liquidity: 709.651,62 EUR (12,0 %)
- Bonds: 3.111.152,42 EUR (52,5 %)
- Equities: 1.157.040,96 EUR (19,5 %)
- Real estate funds: 944.916,95 EUR (16,0 %)

Performance year to date was -1,6 %. [source: weber-report]

Points to keep in mind:
- Our latest valuation is dated 30.09.2026. I have no more recent report, so I can't say what the portfolio is worth today. The family's EUR 6.4 million may come from another date or from a different basis, such as assets held outside our mandate. The records don't say.
- A follow-up meeting was planned for 03.11.2026. [source: weber-note-1] I find no record that it took place, so treat it as a gap. The last record is a personal meeting in the bank on 28.10.2026. [source: weber-note-2]
- The 28.10.2026 note says a callback is due by 19.11.2026. That date hasn't passed yet. [source: weber-note-2]
- At that meeting the family asked whether the equity share (19,5 %) should be reduced. They agreed that nothing would be reallocated before the next appointment. Alternatives were to be reviewed, including Kontor Liquiditätsreserve. [source: weber-note-2]
- On 01.10.2026 the family wanted to keep the conservative risk profile and showed interest in Lindenhof Rentenportfolio. A product sheet was to be sent. [source: weber-note-1]
- The KYC profile was last reviewed on 08.11.2025. [source: weber-kyc]

No, EUR 6.4 million does not match our records.

- The latest portfolio report for the Weber family is dated 30.09.2026. It shows total assets of 5.922.761,95 EUR and year-to-date performance of -1,6 %. [source: weber-report]
- The call note of 01.10.2026 gives the same total. [source: weber-note-1]
- The 28.10.2026 note gives the equity share as 19,5 % (1.157.040,96 EUR). That matches the report. [source: weber-note-2]
- I have no record of a valuation after 30.09.2026, and none that shows EUR 6.4 million. I can't tell from the records why the family's figure is higher. They may be using a different valuation date, or counting assets held outside this mandate. You could ask them where the figure comes from.

Open items:
- The follow-up appointment set for 03.11.2026 is in the past. I find no record that it took place. The 28.10.2026 note describes a personal meeting at the bank, but it doesn't say it replaced that appointment. [source: weber-note-1, weber-note-2]
- A callback is due by 19.11.2026. [source: weber-note-2]
- At the 28.10.2026 meeting the family asked whether the equity share should be reduced. The agreement was no reallocation before the next appointment. Alternatives, including Kontor Liquiditätsreserve, were to be reviewed in the meantime. [source: weber-note-2]
- On 01.10.2026 the family said they were interested in Lindenhof Rentenportfolio, and the product sheet was to be sent. The records don't show whether it was sent. [source: weber-note-1]

The KYC profile lists the risk profile as conservative. The last review was on 08.11.2025. [source: weber-kyc]

content.text:
No, EUR 6.4 million does not match our records for the Weber family.

- The latest portfolio report is dated 30.09.2026. It shows total assets of 5.922.761,95 EUR and year-to-date performance of -1,6 % [source: weber-report].
- The call note of 01.10.2026 gives the same total [source: weber-note-1].
- We have no record of a figure of 6.4 million EUR for the Weber mandate.
- The report is dated 30.09.2026, so I can't say what the portfolio is worth today. The family may be using a different valuation date, or counting assets held outside this mandate. The records don't say.

The report splits the total as follows [source: weber-report]:
- Liquidität: 709.651,62 EUR (12,0 %)
- Anleihen: 3.111.152,42 EUR (52,5 %)
- Aktien: 1.157.040,96 EUR (19,5 %)
- Immobilienfonds: 944.916,95 EUR (16,0 %)

Other points for the call:
- **Open callback:** The note of 28.10.2026 sets a callback by 19.11.2026 [source: weber-note-2].
- **Equity share:** The family asked whether the 19,5 % equity share should be reduced. They agreed that nothing would be moved before the next appointment. Alternatives, including Kontor Liquiditätsreserve, are still being reviewed [source: weber-note-2].
- **Possible gap:** The note of 01.10.2026 planned a follow-up meeting for 03.11.2026 [source: weber-note-1]. I find no record that it took place. The only later record is the in-person meeting of 28.10.2026 [source: weber-note-2].
- **Product sheet:** On 01.10.2026 the family was interested in Lindenhof Rentenportfolio, and a product sheet was to be sent [source: weber-note-1]. I find no record that it was sent.
- **Risk profile:** The profile is conservative, and the family wanted to keep it on 01.10.2026. The KYC record was last reviewed on 08.11.2025 [source: weber-kyc, weber-note-1].
